Title: Your AirPods Hearing Test Came Back Fine? 3 Things to Know About the Hearing Aid Feature

Description:
Apple's Hearing Aid feature got FDA clearance as the first over-the-counter hearing aid software, but it's cleared only for mild-to-moderate hearing loss — severe, sudden, or one-sided loss is excluded. There's no professional fitting behind it, and it's not built for all-day wear like a real hearing aid. If a hearing test shows sudden or one-sided loss, see an ENT doctor before adjusting anything.
